items.title: "Wooden Joe" Nicholas Interview, 1956-11-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember when he played Jim Robinson's horn? ... [INTERVIEWEE] No. I don't think he could do that.

ctx.x: the city. Best in the city. Had the worst horn in the city. He had the all over the world. He could see bubbles. Blowing bubbles. Coming out that horn, something coming out. Where was the last you brought a horn?
By that day we recorded Joe Petit. Do you remember when he played Jim Robinson's horn? He used the slide. He didn't have any teeth at all.
No. I don't think he could do that.
